thread:
Aria Gomez: Need a tight battlecard one-pager for SDRs post-webinar. Audience: mid-market product teams. Requirements: 30s pitch, 2 rebut bullets per competitor (CloudHarbor, PromptFlow, ScaleMesh), one routing map, webinar follow-up email line. Can @Tom take draft? :spiral_calendar:

Tom Hsu: On it. Quick Q: can we quote benchmarks? Dana pasted safe numbers earlier but want phrasing "internal tests". Priya, can you confirm wording?

Priya Nair: Yes use cautious language. Suggest: 'Internal tests on summarization suite: Redwood p50 ~110ms, $0.60/1k; CloudHarbor p50 ~320ms, $1.75/1k.' Link to console for details.

Leo Martins: Competitor bullets: CloudHarbor: breadth of models. Rebut: lacks rollout automation and cost-aware batching. PromptFlow: marketplace pitch; Rebut: limited observability. ScaleMesh: raw scale; Rebut: no KV/prefix caching and poor cost controls. Keep each rebut line <=12 words.

Tom Hsu: Draft outline I'll post: 1) 30s pitch 2) bench line 3) when-to-pick 4) 2 rebut bullets each 5) routing map 6) 1-line email. Also include a small webhook note to tag leads mentioning "bench" so SDRs can send PDF.

Aria Gomez: Routing mapping: if lead mentions SLA -> route to Enterprise AE; POC/trial -> Solutions Eng; self-host/airgap -> Growth; mentions "bench" -> attach bench PDF and route to SDR. Keep this as code snippet.

marketing-bot: Created follow-up task: attach-bench-pdf webhook; review meeting 15m Fri 11:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.example/meet/67890

Priya Nair: Email follow-up line: "We measured Redwood at ~110ms p50 vs 320ms. Watch 90s demo + request a pilot: <link>".

Tom Hsu: I'll drop the one-pager draft here by Thu noon. Please leave edits inline. Need final by Thu EOD for SDRs on Fri outreach. :rocket:
